```python
def median(nums):
    ordered = sorted(nums)
    n = len(ordered)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return ordered[mid]
    return (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2
```

Sure! The median is the middle value of a sorted list. You would sort the numbers and pick the middle one, averaging the two middle values for an even-length list. I hope that explanation helps you understand the approach.
